scene: Your checkmate clatters, and three secret transit doors open together.
picture: A flat side view along the pavilion floor. The elderly player with cane stands beside the defeated automaton at a chess table. Far left, a canal gate opens onto a waiting water taxi. Centre, open glass doors reveal a red monorail carriage. Far right, an archway opens to a sloped funicular car.
shown: a green striped water taxi bobbing at an open canal gate on the far left
a sleek red monorail carriage idling behind open sliding doors in the centre
a sloped wooden funicular rail car waiting at an open archway on the far right
